fields.summary: TC-851-02: Audit Completes Successfully When All Required Flight Fields Are Present

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-851

Precondition: A trip exists with all required flight fields populated (coaTripFirstFltDtm, coaTripLastFltDtm, coaDpFirstFltDtm, coaDpLastFltDtm all non-null). The audit should proceed and complete successfully.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a trip record in DynamoDB with all required flight fields populated and auditNeeded=true
DynamoDB COA record: coaTripFirstFltDtm=2026-03-03T06:00:00Z, coaTripLastFltDtm=2026-03-03T19:00:00Z, coaDpFirstFltDtm populated, coaDpLastFltDtm populated, auditNeeded=true
Trip record exists in DynamoDB with all required flight time fields present
Trigger the Phase 2 audit workflow for the trip (trip release time has passed)
Phase 2 audit triggered with all toggles enabled and trip release time past
Phase 2 audit workflow is invoked successfully
Verify the audit Lambda passes the flight field validation check and proceeds to pay calculation
All required flight fields non-null in the trip record
Audit Lambda passes the missing-field validation and continues to pay audit processing
Verify the audit completes and auditStatus is set to Completed in DynamoDB
DynamoDB audit status field after audit processing with all fields present
auditStatus = Completed in DynamoDB record
Verify the COA Search App shows auditStatus=Completed with populated LCO, LRO, and RRO values
COA Search App queried for the trip after successful audit
COA Search App shows auditStatus=Completed with correct LCO, LRO, RRO override values displayed
